containerDefinitions.name: auth-rds-check
command: import pg from 'pg'; const e=process.env;const c=new pg.Client({host:e.AUTH_DB_HOST,port:5432,database:e.AUTH_DB_NAME,user:e.AUTH_DB_USER,password:e.AUTH_DB_PASSWORD,ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:true,ca:e.AUTH_DB_SSL_CA}});try{await c.connect();await c.query('BEGIN READ ONLY');const r=await c.query("SELECT current_database() AS database, current_user AS role, has_table_privilege(current_user,'public.users','SELECT') AS can_read, (SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid()) AS tls");if(!r.rows[0].can_read||!r.rows[0].tls)throw Error('verification');console.log('CANARY_PASS '+JSON.stringify(r.rows[0]));await c.query('ROLLBACK');await c.end();}catch(x){console.error('CANARY_FAILED '+(x.code||'verification'));process.exit(1)}
